[spoiler=GENDARMITE EXPANSIONISM
800 Words
[nation]Cordone Roleplay Bureau[/nation]]It was the year 1899, seven months after the Great Succession of the Gendarmite throne. Overthrowing the tyrannical Empereur Léo de Lumière-Jaune, the new Kingdom, under the rule of Empress Éloïse de Soleil, was undergoing a new turn, with a developing and rising currency and a strong bartering system. Recent interests in fur trade had sparked due to the large demand from the Elesyran Empires to the East. The undiscovered land of Veron was a vast and hostile forest, containing many different types of furred animals that could potentially bring profit. And so, the Kingdom began setting its interests there.

Mobilization
Due to the recent succession crisis, the army of the Gendarmite Kingdom was vulnerable and unmanageable. Morale was low due to the fighting with the Loyalist forces, and men were exhausted. This was a major issue for the throne, as they needed to reach the land and capture its resources. But without a trained expeditionary force, they wouldn't be able to carry out their plans. This dilemma left the throne puzzled about what to do until they met the Sabaaz people, a local tribe of mercenaries who understood the terrain and would do anything for gold. The leader of the tribe had been a long-time accomplice who helped Éloïse overthrow her uncle and take the throne. They also knew the terrain of the land very well and would comply for a price they found fair. And so, the tribes and the throne worked together, for the price of 2 million USD, equivalent to 35 million USD today. Hiring an army of 400 Sabaaz mercenaries and a couple of Gendarmite mappers, the mission to conquer the East began.

Discovery of Capricornicia and Southern Raj Island
The first army of men ventured south of Gendarmite Capricorn in search of any nearby land. Hours after hours of searching the seas led to failure, and desperate for land, they continued their outrageous mission. That is, until they discovered Capricornicia, an island chain almost 300 miles from the port they had docked at. The men immediately disembarked and began exploring it, finding multiple different animals and rare plant life. The islands were the result of the explosion of a submarine volcano almost 15,000 years ago. The fertile ash from the explosion gave rise to plant and marine life surrounding the island chain. The landlife was questionable, though. A swim from that distance to the island seemed impossible at the time of the explorers, but it was intriguing and interesting to look at. The explorers continued to map the island, naming it the Capricornicia Archipelago after the head expeditionist and captain of the fleet who fearlessly discovered the islands. On the other side of the world, another group of men embarked on their boats to look for land. This time, they had an easier time than the first group. They discovered a major landmass and an island, calling them Southern Rajastan and Porco, respectively. Southern Rajastan was absolutely massive, while Porco was insignificantly smaller. The smaller island would be easier to map and explore, but the larger one posed problems due to a native population that chased them off most of the time. In one of the ensuing battles, 70 mercenaries were killed by a native arrow barrage before they retreated and set a boundary to capture and annex only half of the island. They named these two islands Southern Rajastan and Porco. Setting up a new colony, the throne began to integrate the island into the Kingdom.

Expedition to the East
There was one last plan in Anastasia's lucrative plan: the movement eastward. The Kingdom had forever been confined to the northern part of the peninsula, where they were able to profit and live off of the fish and farms there. But what lay to the east was an even more profitable landscape, ideal for the throne. Anastasia would assign a small army of over 800 mercenaries, explorers, and personal guards to enter the forest. The men began exploring the forest and seeking the land, finding caverns, settlements, and villages across the border. The mission proved to be a success, but soon the men will find out this land had more riches to offer. As they continued, they found another native tribal group. Unlike the ones they had met in Southern Rajastan, these ones were actually cooperative and helped them explore the land. This was pleasing to the throne, as they could now safely explore what lay to the east. They would call this land Juttersland, named after the famous ancient knight Liue Jutter, who fought a battle against the Balmusfids here that led to the survival of the Gendarute Kingdom. The land would soon be incorporated into the Empire and would be the first major feat of the new Empereur Léo de Lumière-Jaune.

[/spoiler]
